rv.q: London Theatre Review: TOSCA, English National Opera, The Coliseum Posted on October 31, 2026 by cherylmarkosky Reply We may not have hit upon the new James Bond yet (my money's on Jack Lowden), but the English National Opera's new production of Giacomo Puccini's Tosca is as thrilling as any spy movie.
Annilese Miskimmon's new staging is the sixth I've encountered at the Coliseum, and easily the worst.

cn.t: Mixed reception for ENO's new Tosca: one critic praises its spy-thriller excitement, while another calls it a "spectacular misfire" with miscasting issues, though Glassberg's conducting earns consistent acclaim.
